title: flowspec/2 — declarative conversational flow definition compiled to LangGraph
description: A single self-contained JSON document describing one citizen-facing service flow. The running ReAct agent loads it and compiles a StateGraph[ServiceState] inside the multi_step_service MCP tool. RAIL fields (the deterministic structure) pin states, slot value-domains, transitions, guards, tool bindings, interrupts, idempotency/reset and guardrails. LLM-FREEDOM fields (non-deterministic execution within the rails) are ONLY: route.description, route.trigger_phrases, every prompt.text (unless verbatim:true), domains.*.normalize hints, and the capabilities the LLM MAY invoke. The boundary is positional: by FIELD (only prompt.text/extract_hint/route.* are LLM-editable), by LOCATION (path/overrides/uses are rails; capabilities is the fenced LLM zone), and by CONSTRUCT (the closed domain IS the boundary — the LLM extracts a candidate, the generated validator rejects out-of-domain).

schema.description: RAIL. Format identifier + major version of THIS spec language (not the flow).

flow.description: RAIL. Stable flow id == service_name; StateManager + checkpointer + config.yaml flow.registry key. Immutable across versions.

version.description: RAIL. Semver of this flow document. Bump per change; diff-friendly.

service.description: RAIL. First-class service-identity metadata (fixes critic A3). Decoupled from any node. Carries SGRC/1746 codes + knowledge ids. Author NEVER puts these in an initialize node.

knowledge_service_id.description: Knowledge-hub id for best-effort context load.

slugs.description: RAIL. Catalog/service-detail slug(s) this flow serves. A host app auto-exposes the guided flow for any service whose slug is listed here, so adding a guided flow is just dropping a JSON with its slug(s) — no host code change. Several slugs may point at one flow.

route.description: LLM-FREEDOM surface. The ONLY hook the top-level ReAct LLM uses to enter this flow. description = the routing hook (non-deterministic route-in). trigger_phrases = a versionable seed, NOT the sole signal. entry_args_schema = the closed set of initial slots the LLM may pass on entry (routing metadata only, never app state).

entry_args_schema.description: JSON-Schema object of slots permitted on flow entry. Keys must be declared slots.

config.description: RAIL. Guardrail booleans consumed by subflows and the engine. Deterministically force skip/default/end. No LLM hook.

entry.description: RAIL. Generic best-effort, NON-terminal entry side-effect (fixes critic A3). Runs once before the path; never asks, never blocks, never resets. Home for 'initialize' node behavior WITHOUT folding service identity into it.

tool.description: Registered tool name to call on entry.

blocking.description: false = failure is swallowed and the flow proceeds.

writes.description: internal/data key the result is stashed under.

domains.description: RAIL + the SPINE. The closed value-domain registry. Each domain materializes FOUR artifacts (fixes critic A1): (1) a Pydantic @field_validator(mode='before') from values+normalize; (2) AgentResponse.payload_schema via model_json_schema() handed to constrained decoding at each pause; (3) interactive button titles; (4) interactive LIST rows {value,description}. Declaring a domain once is the entire structure/execution boundary: values = rail, free-text->token = LLM. The LLM can NEVER widen values (validator raises). normalize is the only LLM-facing hint and is still deterministically enforced.

type.description: Domain kind. 'categorical' uses values[]. Others are built-in validators with special parsing.

values.description: Closed token set for categorical domains. null is allowed as an explicit member. Order is elicitation/button order. One-line append to add a value.

rows.description: Optional per-token descriptive subtitle for two-column LIST interactive (fixes A1). When present, interactive kind:list renders {title:value, description}. Each row.value MUST be a member of values.

normalize.description: Deterministic free-speech -> token coercion strategy, compiled into the before-validator. ENFORCED (rail), authored as a hint. No fuzzy thresholds, no training examples, no per-locale variants.

number_words.description: Map '1'/'um'/'uma' etc. to the positional/synonym token.

affirmation.description: parse_affirmation: sim/yes/isso/thumbs-up -> true; with emoji veto.

synonyms.description: Map of free-text -> token. Each target MUST be a member of values (or true/false for bool).

slots.description: RAIL. Per-slot declarations referenced by path steps, interactive options, and corrections. Binds a stable data key to a domain + persistence partition + collection guardrails. Position is rediscovered from filled slots; NO step pointer is persisted.

persist.description: Which ServiceState partition the slot lives in. 'data' persists+visible; 'internal' persists+hidden; 'payload' ephemeral this-turn.

required.description: Must be filled (when gate-open) before the terminal action is reachable.

nullable.description: Explicit null is an accepted value (e.g. luminaria_localizacao).

requires.description: RAIL. Hard precedence + dependency edges: these slots must be filled before this one is asked, AND this slot's value is invalidated (cleared) when any is corrected. The clear-cascade is DERIVED from this — author declares NOTHING extra (footgun killer).

prefill_sources.description: Channels that may pre-fill this slot (skipping its prompt). e.g. whatsapp_flow, govbr_token.

max_attempts.description: Re-ask budget; engine owns the counter. Defaults to config.max_attempts.

on_exhaust.description: After max_attempts: reask, skip the optional slot, fall back to default, handoff, or END.

default.description: Fallback value applied on skip/default/exhaust (must be a domain member or null).

fill_only_when_asked.description: RAIL (single declarative flag, fixes A9). When true the engine will not auto-fill this slot from a turn that asked a different slot (sensitive slots). NOT a rule engine.

path.description: RAIL. The flat ordered happy path (~80% of every flow). Implicit fall-through: each step is one StateGraph node; linear order is the default edge; the PAUSE->END and back-to-agent edges are SYNTHESIZED (never authored). The step POINTER is never serialized — position = first unfilled gate-passing slot. A step is exactly one of slot | confirm | derive | terminal | use.

uses.description: RAIL + the MINIMALITY lever. Versioned reusable subflows (mixins) composed by id@major + config flags. Splices the subflow's slots+nodes+routers at its anchor in path; inherits invisible idempotency/reset/max-attempt defaults so a new author cannot forget them. The subflow exposes its named slots UPWARD so corrections/requires/terminal mapping can reference them (e.g. address, cpf, email, name).

derive.description: RAIL. Computed values, never asked (escape hatch #1). Lookup-table-ONLY with a single $from[i] fallback — deliberately too weak to be an expression language. Inserted as a no-prompt node that always advances. Prevents value-domain leak: the LLM never computes a classification.

confirm.description: RAIL. The data-confirmation state + non-linear correction routing (escape hatch #2). On Sim -> terminal. On free-text correction the LLM names WHICH correctable slot the citizen meant; the compiler routes to that slot's node and clears it + its transitive requires[]-dependents + derives that read them. Author lists only the directly-correctable slots; the cascade is DERIVED.

terminal.description: RAIL. The single fulfillment action + lifecycle (idempotency/reset/empty-payload). Reachable only when every required gate-open slot is filled. idempotent:true is one flag; the sha256 key recipe + retryable-exception taxonomy stay in the library. Outcome TRICHOTOMY: success (reset_next), retryable (preserve_state, re-enter), fatal (reset_next).

overrides.description: RAIL. The hard-case tier (escape hatches), kept OUT of the linear path so the happy-path read stays clean. Only flows that need them pay. A simple linear service omits this entirely.

gates.description: Multi-slot gate predicates keyed by step id. gate==false => the step's slot is satisfied-by-vacuity (skipped uniformly, no special skip-node). Uses the frozen object grammar.

auto_flow.description: RAIL. Pre-graph WhatsApp Flow gate (NOT a state — it suspends on nfm_reply, not the next text turn). If send_when holds and the entry slot is empty, the compiler sends the Meta Flow envelope and returns status:flow_sent WITHOUT entering the graph. On submission the nfm_reply is re-injected as payload._source=whatsapp_flow and resumed at resume_at. alias_map handles one-Flow-field -> multiple-slots fan-out (fixes A4) bound HARD to a flat value-keyed map (no nested logic).

capabilities.description: FENCED LLM-FREEDOM zone (boundary by LOCATION). Agent-scope non-deterministic side-actions the LLM MAY invoke at its discretion, bounded by the Mule outbound whitelist (cross-checked by the COMPILER against config.yaml, never encoded here). NOT states in the path. await_external is the one reusable out-of-band primitive (fixes A5) with recovery branches.

media_out.description: Outbound media types the LLM may send. A template entry carries a Meta 24h-window template name + variable bindings (fixes A7). Plain types are bare strings.

await_external.description: First-class out-of-band suspend/resume primitive (gov.br OAuth, payment redirect, alternate IdP). Emits an out-of-band send, suspends on an EXTERNAL signal (not the next text turn), resumes populating slots, with recovery branches (abort/resend/switch).

enrich.description: tool to call for extra fields (e.g. get_user_info).

promptDef.description: Citizen-facing fallback text. text is LLM-editable (the LLM may rephrase) UNLESS verbatim:true, which pins legally/contractually fixed wording (gov.br CTA, 1746 disclaimer). extract_hint is LLM guidance for free-text->token extraction (LLM-freedom).

predicate.description: FROZEN object-form predicate grammar (companion artifact A8). Read-only namespaces ONLY: slots.<name>, internal.<name>, payload.<key>, config.<flag>, address.<field>. Operators: in, eq, ne, is_present, and, or, not. No string sugar in canonical flows (the Design-1 fatal break). null is a valid literal.

is_present.description: namespaced ref; true iff filled and non-null.

interactiveDef.description: RAIL. One UI model spanning buttons + list + WhatsApp Flow envelope + out-of-band CTA. field = the payload key the tap fills (binds the affordance to its slot, preventing button/enum drift). options come from from_domain (titles, and list rows from domains.*.rows). options_when adds per-option conditional visibility (fixes A2). gate = the env flag that enables path-B send; when off, prompt.text is the deterministic fallback.

from_domain.description: Domain whose values materialize the options (and rows for list).

options_when.description: Per-option conditional visibility: render value only when its predicate holds (fixes A2).

out_of_band.description: true => the send is pushed direct to Meta (e.g. CTA-URL login); wrapper returns interactive_sent unconditionally.

next_step.description: For out_of_band: the await marker (e.g. await_govbr_auth).

gate.description: Env flag enabling the path-B send; falls back to prompt.text when off.

meta_flow_ref.description: For kind:flow — the registered Meta Flow id (referenced, never inlined).

prefill_from.description: For kind:flow — slots carried into flow_token.

step.description: RAIL. A single path step. Exactly one of slot/confirm/derive/terminal/use is the step kind (mutually exclusive). step id defaults to the slot/derive/terminal target. Single-purpose: a collect step never carries action/branch side effects.
Stable node id. Optional; defaults to slot name or construct name.

slot.description: collect step: references slots{}; pauses iff unfilled.

confirm.description: confirm step: references slots{} (a bool slot); attaches Sim/Não interactive.

derive.description: derive step: references a derive[] target written here in the sequence.

terminal.description: terminal step marker: binds the flow's terminal{} action at this position.

use.description: subflow anchor: references a uses[] ref id (e.g. 'address@1'). Splices the subflow here.

ask_when.description: Inline single-predicate gate: ask this slot only if true (skip-by-vacuity otherwise).

skip_when.description: Inline skip: skip this step entirely if true (e.g. payload._source == whatsapp_flow on the summary).

on_reject.description: For confirm/summary steps: terminal end with a message if the citizen declines.

correctable.description: Marks a confirm step as the correction hub (see confirm{}).

subflowRef.description: RAIL. A versioned mixin reference. ref = name@major (visible, diffable version event). with{} flips the subflow's common_config rails. The subflow brings its own slots/nodes/await_external and inherits idempotency/reset defaults.

deriveDef.description: RAIL. A computed value. Lookup table keyed by '|'.join(from-values) (null member => empty segment, e.g. 'Pendurada||'). default is a literal or the single sigil $from[i] (the i-th source value). after = the step id this derive runs immediately after.

writes.description: data key the result is written to (a derived slot, never asked).

after.description: step id after which this derive node runs.

default.description: literal, or $from[i] (the ONLY deref sigil). Used on lookup miss.

step.description: node id of the confirm state.

on_confirm.description: step/anchor to go to on Sim (usually the terminal/sgrc anchor).

correctable.description: RAIL. The set of directly-correctable slots. The LLM names which one the citizen meant; the compiler routes to its node and clears it + its transitive requires[]-dependents + reading derives. NO clears[] is hand-declared (footgun killer).

idempotent.description: true => compiler computes sha256 key over inputs + replay-caches. Recipe stays in library.

input.description: RAIL. param -> slot binding for the tool call.

outputs.description: RAIL. result-path -> state key (e.g. protocol_id <- result.protocolo).

outcomes.description: RAIL. The outcome trichotomy. success: set+reset_next. retryable: preserve_state, re-enter. fatal: reset_next, END.

empty_payload.description: RAIL. Empty-payload reset semantics. never_saved: reset (treat as fresh). in_progress: ignore (don't wipe mid-flow).

send_when.description: send the Flow envelope (pre-graph) iff true, e.g. not is_present(slots.luminaria_defeito).

resume_at.description: path step id to resume at after nfm_reply submission. Presence past the summary implies the summary is skipped on a Flow submission — the compiler derives summary skip from this (no separate skip_when needed: fixes W3).

alias_map.description: RAIL but BOUNDED (W5). Flat fan-out for Meta-Flow field-shape mismatch ONLY. Outer key = Flow field name. Inner: either a direct slot mapping {slot:value}, OR value-keyed { <flow_value>: {slot:value,...} } for one-field->many-slots. No nested predicates, no transform DSL.

transition.description: A routing target with optional set. Used by await_external timeout/recovery branches.
